articles.title: Dow Jones index struggling for relevance despite adding Amazon , say researchers
articles.title_clean: Dow Jones index struggling for relevance despite adding Amazon , say researchers
articles.article_title: Dow Jones Industrial Average struggling for ‘relevance’ despite Amazon’s addition, say researchers - MarketWatch
articles.article_text: Amazon.com Inc.’s inclusion in the more than 125-year-old Dow Jones Industrial Average still leaves the popular stock-market barometer with a “relevance” problem, according to Ned Davis Researcher. Amazon AMZN replaced Walgreens Boots Alliance Inc. WBA in the Dow DJIA on Monday, giving the 30-stock index more exposure to the megacap technology companies that have helped drive U.S. equity benchmarks to fresh records. Joy Wiltermuth is a news editor and senior markets reporter based in New York. Copyright © 2026 MarketWatch, Inc. All rights reserved.
